and the beautiful moments we spend together...
We're gathering for a birthday night full of

fields.label: Thank-you message
fields.sample:
You made this night unforgettable.
For your kind wishes, your warm smiles and for being by my side,
I thank each and every one of you.
Life truly means more with people like you...
Here's to meeting again for many more birthdays and celebrations...
